_note: Insight reads local transcripts only. It makes no network calls. The budget below is a local gauge: API-list-equivalent dollars for the window, compared with usd.
_costModel: API-LIST-EQUIVALENT. Every dollar figure is what this traffic WOULD cost at the API list prices in pricing.json. On a subscription plan you are not billed per token, so read the numbers as a measure of WORK DONE (and of how expensive a habit is), not as an invoice. Cache reads dominate long sessions - that is the prompt cache being re-read on every call.

burn._note: Ring speed and smoke on the gate. Tokens per minute, computed IN THE PAGE from the totals it already receives. hot = fast spin, blaze = a blur with smoke. Add ?burn=<tokens per minute> to the page URL to see the effect without waiting for a real burn.

team._note: TEAM panel. An agent transcript that moved within activeMs is RUNNING, else IDLE; DONE only when its SubagentHandback was answered. Read from ~/.claude/teams/<team>/config.json and <session>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl - nothing is sampled from CPU.
team._staleNote: An agent quiet (not running) for longer than staleMs is STALE - an earlier run. The TEAM GRAPH shrinks it to a dim outer-ring dot (label on hover) and the TEAM table folds it into a '+N earlier' row.
